load_audio_get_spec: load audio from a video file and return a log filterbank spectrogram tensor
get_spec_from_wav: convert raw wav samples to a normalized log filterbank spectrogram tensor
load_audio_with_jittering: load audio with temporal and volume jittering for data augmentation
get_spec_z_normalize: compute log filterbank spectrogram with z-score normalization
get_spec_custom_filters: generate spectrogram with 257 filterbanks instead of default 40
